stable.headline: Big STEP files mesh on all cores, calmer command cards, smoother drags
notes: Big STEP files are meshed on all cores: the V8 import goes from 103 s to 81 s.
A tool’s card shows the Wireframe on the part in work only.
Command cards: small switches, even rows, no picture on top.
A brighter default light and a plain-text recent-tools list.
No more stalls while idle, scrubbing or dragging on a big model.
Fixes for Edit mesh dots, the far floor grid and a part that stopped drawing.
